zh.thesis: 通过逆向DRAM控制器的地址翻译寄存器，可以触及CPU中所有被隔离的保护内存区域，彻底瓦解安全体系。
paragraphs: 首次披露'DRAM加扰'攻击：利用AMD Family 16h公开的翻译寄存器缺陷，重写物理地址映射，使任何地址都能落到受保护内存。
该方法已成功提取PSP（平台安全处理器）的RSA密钥、SMM（系统管理模式）处理代码及C6休眠状态寄存器内容，证明现有隔离机制形同虚设。
问题根源在内存层级的最底层——各厂商的内存控制器均采用类似加扰逻辑，意味着Intel、ARM、RISC-V同样面临威胁，影响面远超AMD单平台。

en.thesis: By reverse-engineering the address-translation registers in a DRAM controller, an attacker can reach every protected memory region in the CPU, dismantling the entire security architecture.
paragraphs: A newly disclosed 'DRAM scrambling' attack exploits a flaw in the publicly documented translation registers of AMD Family 16h to rewrite the physical address mapping, so that any address can be redirected into protected memory.

The method has already extracted the RSA keys of the Platform Security Processor (PSP), the System Management Mode (SMM) handler code, and the contents of the C6 sleep-state registers, showing that existing isolation mechanisms are effectively useless.

The root cause lies at the lowest level of the memory hierarchy: every vendor's memory controller uses similar scrambling logic, so Intel, ARM, and RISC-V face the same threat, and the impact goes far beyond AMD's single platform.

articles.title: The Quest For Caffeine You Can Have At Night
articles.author: Scott Alexander

zh.thesis: 想在晚上喝咖啡又不失眠，代用兴奋剂可行，但首选是帕拉黄嘌呤，而非风险高的芦他卡品。
paragraphs: 咖啡因经肝酶CYP1A2转为帕拉黄嘌呤，总有效半衰期约十小时。想让兴奋早点消退，有三条路：诱导酶、直接吃代谢物、或用短效类似物。
芦他卡品能三小时让酶升三倍，把代谢压到四小时，但会持续两天，且可能伤肝。帕拉黄嘌呤安全得多——咖啡因的80%本就变成它，但只有三分之二用户有效。
甲基金嘌呤半衰期仅1.5小时，但评价好坏参半，还可能抑制代谢酶。综合安全性与好评率，帕拉黄嘌呤是实用答案，剂量50-200毫克，药效约为咖啡因一半时长。

en.thesis: For those who want caffeine at night without the insomnia, a substitute stimulant works, but paraxanthine is the better choice over the riskier lisuride-like compound rutacarpine.
paragraphs: Caffeine is converted by the liver enzyme CYP1A2 into paraxanthine, with an overall effective half-life of about ten hours. To make the stimulation wear off sooner, there are three strategies: induce the enzyme, take the metabolite directly, or use a short-acting analogue.

Rutacarpine can triple the enzyme within three hours, compressing metabolism to four hours, but its effects last two days and it may harm the liver. Paraxanthine is far safer—80% of caffeine already becomes it, though it works for only two-thirds of users.

Methylxanthine has a half-life of just 1.5 hours, but reviews are mixed and it may inhibit metabolic enzymes. Balancing safety and user satisfaction, paraxanthine is the practical answer, dosed at 50-200 milligrams, with roughly half the duration of caffeine.

articles.title: Medicare for All should be more like Medicare
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: 「全民医保」不应照搬加拿大模式，而应仿照现有美国联邦医保项目设计，才更可行且符合民意。
paragraphs: 「全民医保」口号响亮，因「医保」是受大众欢迎的既有项目，且民众普遍认同医疗不应取决于支付能力。但这一原则无法直接落地，因为现实中不可能无限提供免费医疗。
不同国家有不同解法，而美国左翼的「全民医保」提案多参照加拿大体系。但作者主张，既然口号借力于美国联邦医保的声望，具体方案就该更贴近美国现有制度，而非另起炉灶。
这意味着在普遍覆盖与资源约束间寻找平衡，借鉴美国医保的既有结构和运作经验，而非照搬他国模式。如此才能兼顾理想与可行，赢得更广泛的政治支持。

en.thesis: 'Medicare for All' should not be a wholesale transplant of the Canadian model; it ought to be built on the design of the existing U.S. federal Medicare program, which would make it more feasible and more in line with public opinion.
paragraphs: The rallying cry of 'Medicare for All' works because 'Medicare' is a popular existing program, and people broadly agree that healthcare should not depend on one's ability to pay. Yet this principle cannot be directly implemented, since in reality there is no such thing as unlimited free medical care.

Different countries offer different solutions, and most U.S. progressive proposals under this banner draw on the Canadian system. The author, however, argues that since the slogan borrows its appeal from the prestige of the American federal Medicare program, the actual plan should stick closer to the existing U.S. framework rather than starting from scratch.

That means finding a balance between universal coverage and resource constraints, drawing on Medicare's established structure and operational experience rather than copying a foreign model. Only in this way can the ideal be reconciled with what is workable, winning broader political support.

articles.title: Google's AI found a Chrome bug hiding for 13 years, and it's only getting faster
articles.author: Rich Edmonds

zh.thesis: AI不仅能发现潜伏十三年之久的Chrome漏洞，还能自动生成补丁，正在重塑浏览器安全的攻防节奏。
paragraphs: 谷歌用专门的模型处理Chrome安全流程：发现漏洞、分类报告、生成候选补丁并测试。结果是在Chrome 149和150中修复了1072个安全漏洞，超过过去23个版本的总和，还找出存在超十年的老问题。
但这并非简单的聊天式提问，而是多智能体协作：修复代理生成多种补丁，另一代理评估，开发者最终审查。谷歌还与DeepMind和Project Zero合作，每日扫描变更，仅五月就避免了20多个漏洞进入正式版。
AI加速也带来新矛盾：漏洞发现更快，但补丁发布和用户更新存在延迟，形成所谓的补丁缺口。为此谷歌转向双周大版本加每周安全更新，甚至探索动态打补丁和自动重启浏览器，意在把Chrome变成常新服务，但攻击者同样能用AI寻找漏洞，这成了军备竞赛。

en.thesis: Google's AI not only uncovered a Chrome vulnerability that had lurked for 13 years but also auto-generated a fix, resetting the tempo of browser security as an offensive-defensive race.
paragraphs: Google deployed a dedicated model to handle Chrome's security workflow: spotting flaws, triaging reports, generating candidate patches, and testing them. The result: 1,072 security bugs were fixed across Chrome 149 and 150, more than the previous 23 versions combined, including the decade-old problem that had gone unnoticed.

But this wasn't a simple chat-style query—it was a multi-agent collaboration: a fixer agent produced multiple patches, another agent evaluated them, and developers did the final review. Google also worked with DeepMind and Project Zero to scan changes daily, and in May alone, the effort kept more than 20 vulnerabilities from reaching the stable release.

The AI acceleration brings a new contradiction: flaws are found faster, but patch delivery and user updates lag behind, creating what's known as a patch gap. To close it, Google shifted to biweekly major releases plus weekly security updates, even exploring dynamic patching and automatic browser restarts, aiming to turn Chrome into a constantly refreshed service. Yet attackers can equally use AI to hunt for bugs, turning this into an arms race.

zh.thesis: 《独自打保龄》的预言已被验证，但其因果链条和解决方案仍然模糊。
paragraphs: 作者重读此书，发现中心比喻占篇幅极少，而争议性的预测——教会衰败、互联网无法替代面对面社交——如今看来都站对了。
但合著者质疑其因果链不清，并认为该书呼应了反自由主义的时代 backlash。两人同意电视被低估：它解释了一半的社交资本下滑，却未得到足够关注或对策。
若电视（乃至今日流媒体）确是主因，那么问题的核心或不在组织形态，而在媒介内容本身——这指向比 Putnam 更激进的重估。

en.thesis: The prophecy of 'Bowling Alone' has been confirmed, but its causal chain and solutions remain unclear.
paragraphs: Re-reading the book, the author finds that the central metaphor occupies surprisingly little space, while its more contentious predictions—such as the decline of churches and the inability of the internet to replace face-to-face interaction—have both proven correct.

Yet the co-author questions the clarity of its causal chain and suggests the book echoed a backlash against liberalism at the time. Both agree that television was underestimated: it accounts for half of the decline in social capital, yet it received insufficient attention or policy response.

If television—and today's streaming—is indeed the main culprit, then the core of the problem may lie not in organizational forms but in the content of the medium itself, which points to a more radical reassessment than Putnam's.

articles.title: My very interesting Conversation with Daron Acemoglu
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 左翼自由主义因其自身精英权力的滥用而败落，而非仅仅败于外部挑战。
paragraphs: 在与泰勒·考恩的对谈中，阿西莫格鲁借新书《自由民主怎么了》反思：左翼自由主义近八十年掌权却未善用权力，内部腐化使其不堪一击。他类比罗马衰亡，归因于内忧而非外患。
他拒绝提供终极仲裁标准，只坚持个人自由是起点，社会共识是过程。价值冲突时，他倾向非支配而非不干预，强调社区层面需抵御强权，但承认这是不完美的答案。
对谈覆盖自动化与繁荣、教师工会改革、AI对生产力的影响等。核心是：现代自由主义的危机源于精英脱离民众，振兴需重新赢得信任而非固守既有教条。

en.thesis: Left-liberalism has fallen not merely to external challenges but to its own abuse of elite power.
paragraphs: In a conversation with Tyler Cowen, Acemoglu reflects on his new book about liberal democracy's troubles: left-liberalism has held power for nearly eight decades but failed to use it well, and internal decay has left it vulnerable. He draws an analogy to the fall of Rome, attributing the decline to internal rot rather than external invasion.

He refuses to offer a final arbiter of values, insisting only that individual freedom is the starting point and social consensus is the process. When values clash, he leans toward non-domination rather than non-interference, emphasizing that communities need protection against powerful forces — though he admits this is an imperfect answer.

The discussion ranges over automation and prosperity, teacher union reform, and AI's impact on productivity. The core message is that modern liberalism's crisis stems from elites losing touch with ordinary people, and renewal requires winning back trust rather than clinging to established doctrines.

zh.thesis: 若真忧心AI灭世的风险，就该买远期看跌期权对冲，而非只口头警告。
paragraphs: 考恩批评那些担忧AI毁灭人类的人言行不一：既说风险巨大，却不肯花小钱买保险。他建议每年花5千到1万美元买入深度价外看跌期权，其余资产照常做多。
关键是这些人的做空仓位暴露真实信念——口头警告而拒绝行动，说明心底其实相信AI不会太糟。市场对长期特殊风险定价失效，反而更该用期权对冲。
他自认与尼德霍夫相近，反对净做空，但认为买保险式期权合理。若真错判，权当保险费；若赌对，中途恐慌期即可兑现，无需赌到末日。

en.thesis: If genuinely worried about the risk of AI destroying humanity, one should buy far-out-of-the-money put options as a hedge, not just issue verbal warnings.
paragraphs: Cowen criticizes those who fear AI's potential to wipe out humanity for being inconsistent: they claim the risk is enormous yet refuse to spend a small amount on insurance. He suggests spending five to ten thousand dollars a year on deep out-of-the-money puts while keeping the rest of the portfolio long.

The key is that these people's short positions reveal their true beliefs—verbal warnings without action indicate that deep down they think AI won't be that bad. Since the market fails to price long-term tail risks properly, options are an even more appropriate hedge.

He aligns himself with Niederhoffer in opposing net short positions but finds buying insurance-like options reasonable. If he's wrong, it's just a premium; if he's right, he can cash in during the panic phase without waiting for doomsday.

articles.title: Google recommends these 7 NotebookLM prompts, and they showed me what I was missing
articles.author: Mahnoor Faisal

zh.thesis: Google 推荐的七个 NotebookLM 提示词展示了工具从问答走向主动执行任务的转型，但学生用户可能感到疏离。
paragraphs: 作者测试了 Google 官方推荐的提示词，发现 NotebookLM 已能从原始资料生成测验、PDF 学习指南，甚至自动从课程大纲提取 URL 添加为源，省去繁琐的手动操作。
商务提示词更具突破性，例如计算各产品线营收增长并绘图，或结合网络搜索与内部文档给出营销建议，体现其新增的云端代码执行和代理式搜索能力。
个人场景如整理装修收据成表格或分析房产购买，将上传资料、网络调研和预测建模整合为可直接使用的成品，但作者仍担忧这偏离了原先以引文为根基的可靠学习体验。

en.thesis: Google's seven recommended NotebookLM prompts reveal the tool's shift from answering questions to executing tasks, but student users may feel alienated.
paragraphs: The author tested Google's officially recommended prompts and found that NotebookLM can now generate quizzes, PDF study guides, and even automatically extract URLs from course syllabi to add as sources, saving the tedious manual work.

The business prompts are more groundbreaking, such as calculating revenue growth for each product line and plotting it, or combining web searches with internal documents to give marketing advice, reflecting its new cloud-based code execution and agentic search capabilities.

Personal scenarios like organizing renovation receipts into a table or analyzing a property purchase integrate uploaded materials, web research, and predictive modeling into a ready-to-use product, but the author still worries this deviates from the original reliable learning experience rooted in citations.

articles.title: I Deleted My Calendar Link. And I’m Never Going Back
articles.author: JA Westenberg

zh.thesis: 删除日历链接、回归人工约会议，是夺回时间自主权的必要代价。
paragraphs: 作者曾迷信Calendly等工具能消除约会议摩擦，却发现自己成了被动的资源，别人随意占用他的时间。他发现多数会议本就无意义，且越没用的人越爱开会，而自动预约反而让时间商品化，变成无限加购的购物车。
于是他删掉链接，强迫双方通过简短交流确认会议目的与必要性。虽然协调成本变高，但能筛掉大量无效约见，让时间回归个人掌控。他认为日历应是重要事项的记录，而非任人挑选的空档市场。

en.thesis: Deleting my calendar link and going back to manually scheduling meetings was a necessary price for reclaiming control over my own time.
paragraphs: The author once believed that tools like Calendly could eliminate the friction of scheduling meetings, only to find himself reduced to a passive resource whose time others could arbitrarily occupy. He discovered that most meetings were meaningless to begin with, and that the less useful a person was, the more they loved to call meetings; automated booking, meanwhile, turned time into a commodity, like an endlessly replenished shopping cart.

So he deleted the link, forcing both parties to confirm the purpose and necessity of a meeting through brief exchanges. Although coordination costs went up, it filtered out a large number of ineffective appointments and brought time back under personal control. In his view, a calendar should be a record of important matters, not a marketplace of open slots for anyone to pick from.

zh.thesis: DeepSeek Harness将代理能力全面插件化，但这是发布公告而非论证。
paragraphs: DeepSeek推出Harness开发者预览版，基于Cordis插件系统，模型、工具、技能等皆可替换组合，宣称「一切皆插件」。它记录模型所见全部会话日志，支持轨迹查看与恢复、分叉。
提供标准、代码、最小、创建者四种运行模式，代码模式让模型以TypeScript程序编排多轮工具调用。源码开源（MIT），经npx即可启动。
这本质是产品发布：宣布能力与开源，未给出设计权衡或性能对比。对构建代理的开发者是实用消息，但缺乏可争辩论点，故评分较低。

en.thesis: DeepSeek Harness fully pluginizes agent capabilities, but this is a release announcement, not an argument.
paragraphs: DeepSeek has unveiled a developer preview of Harness, built on the Cordis plugin system, where models, tools, skills, and more can be swapped and combined, touting 'everything is a plugin.' It logs all session interactions the model sees, with support for trajectory viewing, resuming, and forking.

Four run modes are provided: standard, code, minimal, and creator. The code mode lets the model orchestrate multi-turn tool calls as a TypeScript program. The source is open under the MIT license, and it can be launched via npx.

Essentially, this is a product release: it announces capabilities and open-sourcing, without detailing design trade-offs or performance comparisons. For developers building agents, it’s practical news, but it offers little to debate, hence the low score.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank becomes first foreign yuan clearing bank in Europe
articles.author: Markoff

zh.thesis: 德意志银行成为欧洲首家人民币清算行，是中欧金融基础设施的实质性进展。
paragraphs: 该行获准在法兰克福开展人民币清算，这是中国央行首次在欧洲指定清算行。此前人民币清算多集中于亚洲，此举意味着欧洲企业可直接经德国完成人民币交易。
清算行是境外人民币流动的枢纽，能降低交易成本、提升效率。对德企而言，对华贸易结算将更便捷，也可能推动更多欧洲央行将人民币纳入储备。
然而，这更多是制度性安排而非市场突破。实际影响取决于人民币在国际交易中的使用意愿，短期内难以改变美元主导格局，但为人民币国际化迈出关键一步。

en.thesis: Deutsche Bank becoming Europe's first yuan clearing bank is a substantive step forward in Sino-European financial infrastructure.
paragraphs: The bank has been authorized to conduct yuan clearing in Frankfurt, marking the first time China's central bank has designated a clearing bank in Europe. Previously, yuan clearing was largely concentrated in Asia, and this move means European companies can now settle yuan transactions directly through Germany.

As a hub for offshore yuan liquidity, a clearing bank reduces transaction costs and improves efficiency. For German firms, trade settlement with China becomes more convenient, and it may also encourage more European central banks to include the yuan in their reserves.

However, this is more of an institutional arrangement than a market breakthrough. The actual impact depends on the willingness to use the yuan in international transactions, and it is unlikely to change the dollar-dominated landscape in the short term, but it does mark a crucial step for yuan internationalization.

articles.title: New York is building. But where?
articles.author: Halina Bennet

zh.thesis: 纽约市长马姆达尼的「第二住宅税」遭法官暂停，显示其住房计划遭遇法律阻力。
paragraphs: 马姆达尼计划对高价第二住宅征税以助保障房，但史泰登岛法官奥齐周一叫停，因诉讼或源于程序或宪法问题。
此举是住房改革的最新挫折，此前市长曾承诺放宽分区、增加供给。后续法院裁决将决定政策能否推进，以及纽约市能否兑现建设承诺。

en.thesis: New York City Mayor Mamdani's 'second-home tax' has been temporarily blocked by a judge, signaling legal hurdles for his housing plan.
paragraphs: Mamdani's plan to tax high-priced second homes to fund affordable housing was halted on Monday by Staten Island Judge Ozzi, after a lawsuit raised potential procedural or constitutional issues.

This setback is the latest in a series of challenges to housing reforms, coming after the mayor had earlier vowed to relax zoning and boost supply. Future court rulings will determine whether the policy can proceed and whether New York City can fulfill its promise to build.

zh.thesis: 在技术圈里，坚持己见而非随大流，才是真正的护城河。
paragraphs: 文章批评技术人都在套用同一套成功剧本，主张用「信念」而非「共识」来建立独特优势。观点激进，但缺乏具体案例支撑，更像个人宣言。
作者以「异端雇佣兵」自居，号召读者停止贩卖技能、转而卖观点。然而通篇未给出操作细节或证据，仅有对主流文化的嘲讽，说服力有限。

en.thesis: In tech, holding your own convictions rather than following the crowd is the true moat.
paragraphs: The article criticizes tech professionals for all following the same playbook for success, advocating for using 'conviction' rather than 'consensus' to build a unique advantage. The viewpoint is radical but lacks concrete case support, reading more like a personal manifesto.

The author styles himself as a 'heretical mercenary,' urging readers to stop selling skills and instead sell opinions. However, throughout, he offers no operational details or evidence, only mockery of mainstream culture, which limits its persuasiveness.

zh.thesis: 这是链接汇总，无独立论点，仅提供各话题的入口。
paragraphs: 文章是典型的每日链接集合，涵盖写论文用AI、医学未来、可推广性研究、中国AI伴侣监管及手机与冲突关系。
每个链接仅有一句提示，如「每个疾病都是政策失误」，缺乏展开论证或数据支持，价值在于索引而非分析。
对通才读者而言，可作为发现话题的起点，但本摘要无法提炼实质内容，因原文本身未提供深度信息。

en.thesis: This is a collection of links with no central argument, serving only as entry points to various topics.
paragraphs: The article is a typical daily roundup of links, covering topics such as using AI for thesis writing, the future of medicine, research on generalizability, regulation of AI companions in China, and the relationship between mobile phones and conflict.
Each link comes with only a one-line teaser, such as 'every disease is a policy failure,' without expanded argumentation or supporting data; its value lies in indexing rather than analysis.
For a general reader, it can serve as a starting point for discovering topics, but this summary cannot extract substantive content because the original itself does not provide in-depth information.

articles.title: Codex in ChatGPT desktop app for Linux is now in preview
articles.author: allanrbo

zh.thesis: ChatGPT 桌面版与 Codex 登陆 Linux 预览，但只是一次产品发布，缺乏分析价值。
paragraphs: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT 桌面应用现已在 Linux 上提供预览，支持 ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work 和 Codex，并适配了工作流与浏览器操作。
这则消息对长期等待的 Linux 用户是解脱，但本质是版本更新公告，没有涉及技术细节或市场影响，因此更像新闻而非分析。

en.thesis: ChatGPT's desktop app and Codex arrive on Linux as a preview, but this is a product announcement with little analytical substance.
paragraphs: OpenAI has made its ChatGPT desktop application available for Linux in preview, bringing ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex to the platform, complete with workflow and browser operation support.
For Linux users who have waited long, this is a relief, but essentially it is a version update notice, lacking technical depth or market implications, so it reads more like news than analysis.

zh.thesis: 一篇仅转发外部链接的简短事实帖，缺乏展开论证。
paragraphs: 该文只是转载了一个来源链接，标题为「美国今日事实」，正文几乎没有内容。
